collection.title: Renault Megane Sport Tourer 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Renault Megane Sport Tourer 2006 to 2009 will fit, this model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Megane which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
